product_metadata.title: Lavish Home Wall Decor – Metallic Wire Layer Flower Sculpture Contemporary Hanging Accent Art for Living Room, Bedroom or Kitchen (Silver and Gold), 15” L x 1.75” W x 15” H
features: FLORAL OPENWORK- This nature inspired art is sure to enhance the beauty of your living spaces. The beautifully layered wire petal details add visual depth and dimension to create an elegant wall sculpture.

VERSATILE DÉCOR- This decorative piece features a silver and distressed gold finish that blends rustic and modern styles to add flair to bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, or entryways. You can hang it individually or in a group for a unique display.
EASY HANGING- This wall art doesn’t require any assembly. It mounts effortlessly to almost any wall with the built-in hanger. The included mounting hardware keeps it safe and secure on your wall.

STYLISH GIFT- This floral wall art would be a welcome addition to any room in your home or office. It makes an ideal gift for housewarming parties, weddings, holidays or other occasions. You can buy two or more to create stunning ensembles.
PRODUCT DETAILS- Materials: Iron. Dimensions: 15” L x 1.75” W x 15” H. Color: Silver with Distressed Gold. Includes Mounting Hardware. Indoor Use Only.
description: Add a modern flair to your home with the Silver and Gold Wire Flower Wall Art by Lavish Home. This wall hanging adds visual dimension and depth with its layered wire floral design. It’s crafted from iron metal and features a silver and distressed gold finish to create a modern floral sculpture. It conveniently features a keyhole hanger and includes hardware for easy wall mounting to add unique style to your home. Display in multiples to create your own statement pieces or to enhance a wall gallery. The openwork metal art would make a fantastic gift for housewarming parties, weddings, holidays or other occasions. Your friends and family will love this eye-catching piece.
